## ExecutableTrustStatus.hashMismatch property

`true` when the executable is already known to the manifest but its current hash does not match any approved value — a TOFU conflict. A conflicting executable is never trusted; callers must re-approve or deny.

**Signature:**

```typescript
hashMismatch: boolean;
```
